scienceBluetooth.startBluetooth: Run once at program start. In Bowerbird choose micro:bit Bluetooth and connect.
scienceBluetooth.bluetoothConnected: True once Bowerbird has connected to the board.
scienceBluetooth.sendBluetooth|block: send values $values to Bowerbird by Bluetooth
scienceBluetooth.sendBluetooth: Put several sensor readings in the array in order; they are sent together as one comma-separated line. Nothing is sent before connection. No headers or units are sent.
scienceBluetooth.sendValueBluetooth|bloc: send measurement $value to Bowerbird by Bluetooth
scienceBluetooth.sendValueBluetooth: Put a single sensor reading in this block. Nothing is sent before connection.
